context: A police officer briefs on financial compliance
purpose: Teach: ポートフォリオ/プリンター/返金/レジュメ/数式/パートナーシップ/概算/アフター

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 御社のポートフォリオ、健全です。
lines.style: Even, professional opening. Measured cadence. The brief approval of someone reading from experience, not suspicion. Slight nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。プリンター記録、監査用に保存しています。
lines.en: Yes. We keep printer logs for audit purposes.
lines.style: Immediate, cooperative. Clean articulation — showing readiness without over-eagerness. The tone of someone already thinking ahead to the next step.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 返金詐欺、報告が増えています。
lines.style: Shift to official register. Steady, informative. The weight of routine bad news. No alarm — just statement of fact that requires attention.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。応募レジュメの照合、慎重に行います。
lines.style: Quick acknowledgment, then slight lean forward. The assurance of someone committing to specifics. Not defensive — just clear about process.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 評価数式、不正にならないよう、外部監査も。
lines.en: Assessment formulas need external audit too — to prevent irregularities.
lines.style: Procedural, precise. Light emphasis on 「external」. The tone of laying out what must happen next. Professional, no negotiation in the phrasing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察との情報パートナーシップ、強化します。
lines.en: We'll strengthen our information-sharing partnership with the police.
lines.style: Firm commitment. Direct eye contact in the voice. The tone of someone stepping up, not just complying — ownership of the next move.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 概算情報、社内アフターケアにも反映を。
lines.en: Make sure preliminary data reflects in internal aftercare too.
lines.style: Closing instruction, delivered quietly but with weight. The tone of tying things together. Slight pause before the final phrase — letting it land.
